text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts from inference-gateway (us-east-1). Severity: P1. Alert rule: https://ops.redwood/internal/alerts/INF-GW-5XX-THRESHOLD — paging @ava for primary on-call.

ava: acked — I'm oncall. seeing spikes ~00:40 UTC, 5xx rate ~7% sustained on gateway for last 8m. hitting /v1/chat and /v1/generate primarily.

liam: I'm nearby, can help with LB/Envoy. Ava, can you post a sample request id or curl showing 502?

ava: paste logs from edge-proxy:```2026-03-12T00:42:10Z edge-proxy srv=ingress gateway=svc-inference path=/v1/generate req_id=6f3a2  upstream=route-A status=502 latency_ms=12 error="upstream reset"```

ava: curl example returning 502:```curl -i -X POST https://gw.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hello"}'```

sara: I'm seeing very high 503 bursts from route weight group 'model-a-fast' vs fallback. Envoy logs show retries piling up and then circuit-breaker tripping on the pool.

nate: On the metrics: retries per request spiked 3x around 00:38, then connection failures. p95 latency to backend increased from 60ms -> 400ms. Customer impact: CS queue has 6 tickets from large inference customers seeing 502/timeout.

jess: Playbook step: If this is LB routing/retry cascade, disable retries on gateway for the affected route to stop amplification. Recommend quick change: set retries: 0 for /v1/* on inference-gateway and reduce per-try timeout.

maria: Agreed. Putting a temporary rule in place now. Executing:```kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gateway-envoy --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/routes/retry_policy","value":"none"}]'``` — rolling to 2 proxies then evaluate.

andre: Adding a second mitigation: lower route weight for model-a-fast to 50% and shift 50% to model-a-stable to reduce backend pressure. Command:```trafficctl set-weight inference/model-a 50 --target model-a-stable```

ava: Done: retries disabled on the active proxy (rolling). Observed immediate drop in retries metric and 5xx rate falling to ~2.1% after 2 minutes.

liam: Good. Can we also bump the circuit-breaker max connections temporarily so partial failures don't cascade? On node group we can set cb.max_connections from 100 -> 200 while we investigate.

kevin: Caution: increasing CB limits can increase backend load; let's do small step: 100 -> 140. I'll apply to the affected pool only. Command:```envoy-admin '/runtime_modify?key=cb.max_connections&value=140'```

ops-bot: deploy: rollout/gateway-envoy v2.14 -> success on node a,b (2/2).

nate: post-change metrics: 5xx down to 1.2%  (was 7%). retries per request back to baseline. However p95 latency still elevated for some tails around 300ms.

jess: Next investigative steps: collect backend logs for model-a-fast instances showing OOM / GC / slow startup. Also check kernel level connection resets.

maria: Pulling backend logs now — found a thread dump on model-a-fast node: high memory pressure and worker thread stalls around same timestamps. Possible memory leak/quantization jar issue.

sara: That suggests backend health causing Envoy to retry and then trigger circuits. We should keep retries disabled while backend teams patch.

ava: Customer impact summary for ops/jira/CS: ~3% of global requests affected, mostly large-batch customers on dedicated capacity, some increased latency for hosted API keys hitting model-a-fast. No data loss, transient errors. CS notified and given escalation link.

liam: Action items: (1) backend team to roll a hotfix to free memory on model-a-fast (andre+backend), (2) keep retry policy disabled until validation, (3) maintain reduced route weight, (4) monitor 5xx and latency.

andre: Will push hotfix in canary first. Triggering canary rollout to 2 instances:```kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-a-fast model-a-fast=registry/redwood/model-a:hotfix-20260312``` — canary started.

kevin: I'll keep an eye on circuit-breaker metrics; reverting cb.max_connections to 100 once downstream healthy.

ops-bot: alert cleared? No — monitoring threshold not yet satisfied. Continue watch.

nate: Timeline note: incident started 00:38 UTC, mitigated to reduced impact by 00:46 UTC after retry disable and weight shift. Full resolution pending hotfix validation.

jess: Logging a short post-incident checklist in the incident ticket: include trafficctl commands, config patches, metrics snapshot, and CS notes.

ava: oncall handoff in 90m to liam. I'll prepare status summary in the ticket and link to the canary logs.

liam: I'll take over when you go offline. ping me if canary fails. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sara: One last note — consider adding a protective rule: auto-disable retries when backend 5xx > 2% for >1m to avoid amplification. Filing an RFC after incident.

incident-bot: SUMMARY: mitigations applied: retries disabled on gateway, route weight shifted 50%->stable, circuit-breaker max_connections increased to 140 (temporary), backend canary hotfix deployed. Impact: transient 5xx for ~8m, degraded for ~3% of requests. Follow-up: backend hotfix validation, automation RFC for auto-disable retries.
